item.title: Rallying Cry – October 21, 2026
item.description: Singapore climbs to 14th in global rule of law rankings, a new app helps visually impaired diners at hawker centres, and scientists reconstruct the face of the oldest known Homo sapiens—plus, don’t miss the Orionids meteor shower peaking this week!
